name: Realizable Successive Upper-Cube Pattern
definition: A 23-concept ample family has a successful prefix whose three corner supports are $\{p,q,r\}$, $\{p,q,e\}$, and $\{p,q,f\}$, where $e\ne f$.
parameters: Deleting either marked switch corner gives a 22-concept side.
properties: Both 22-concept switch sides peel to the root. Thus the successive upper-cube pattern forced in a minimum repair is realizable, but the pattern alone does not imply endpoint failure.
